payload_semantics.depth_0_to_4: One float32 arithmetic mean of the node's covered delta dimensions.
payload_semantics.depth_5: Exact ordered float32 values for the leaf's 64 covered delta dimensions.

purpose: Define a deterministic Forest-free MAF-3D representation hierarchy before any route-conditioned learning or Qwen activation outcome is computed.

reconstruction.depth_0_to_4: Fill every covered dimension with that node's stored mean, producing a complete 2048-D piecewise-constant delta approximation.
reconstruction.depth_5: Concatenate/scatter the 32 exact 64-D leaf payloads into original dimension order.
reconstruction.full_leaf_requirement: Depth-5 reconstruction must be bitwise identical to the float32 input delta before any activation-corpus experiment is permitted.

representation.input_object: layer-transition delta = normalized target hidden state - normalized source hidden state
representation.normalization: source and target hidden states use the frozen Qwen prospective tensor L2-normalization semantics before delta construction
